lines.text: Come in, both of you. How's the neck been since last time?
Since last time the headaches have dropped to about two a week.
From last time I'd guess it's more like three headaches a week.
Either way it's heading the right direction. The needles seemed to help, so I'll do those again today along with some work on the joints.
Yes please, the needles were brilliant, I've no doubt that's what's made the difference.
Turning to the left is still the stiffer direction, you're about 20 degrees short of the right.
When you're at the laptop, prop it up on a couple of books so your eyes are level with the top of the screen.
I'll make sure he does that.
Right, hop on the couch, shirt off, and we'll get started.
